developmentObservations: Initial native compiler output repeated primary diagnostics in source excerpts; singular SwiftLint violations and nested XCTest totals required stricter measured handling.
Native compiler dump includes mixed metadata/children and closure captures; measured grammar and malformed/near-miss controls were added.
Sequential XCTest lifecycle exposes native skips that parallel XML omitted; every nested suite and callback is reconciled.
Swift Testing XML counts methods/issue records, while V0 events identify parameter cases. Numeric XML references required one-pass decoding without changing escaped reference-looking text.

Reached compiled XCTest helper entered a separate process group and survived group-only cancellation. The shared runner now checks observed descendant ancestry and fresh identities before descendant-first termination.
Original-group membership erased ancestry depth in the first cleanup implementation. A red in-group parent/child control now checks ancestry-derived termination ordering.

Native SwiftLint progress counters can be printed in order 1,3,2. A reproduced receipt and the pinned concurrent visitor support order-independent unique bounded counter reconciliation, with duplicate/gap/out-of-range/wrong-total controls.
The available Apple Swift 6.4 command-line SDK could not resolve XCTest/Testing; full macOS native build/test is not promoted.
